operators.name: hardshrink_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided, supports non-overlapping strides

semantics: Applies hard-shrink with lambd=0.5 as in F.hardshrink(x, lambd=0.5), elementwise: if abs(x_i) > 0.5 then x_i, else 0.
Preserves shape and stride; output is a new tensor with same memory layout as input.
Function is equivalent to the first reference checkpoint step_001.

operators.name: elu_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided, supports non-overlapping strides

semantics: Applies ELU with alpha=1.0 as in F.elu(x): elementwise, if x_i >= 0 then x_i, else exp(x_i)-1.
Preserves shape and stride; output is a new tensor with same memory layout as input.
Function is equivalent to the second reference checkpoint step_002.

operators.name: hardshrink_elu_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or strided, supports non-overlapping strides

semantics: Combined elementwise operation that sequentially applies hardshrink(lambd=0.5) then elu(alpha=1.0) in a single pass.
For each element: first h = x if abs(x) > 0.5 else 0; then y = h if h >= 0 else exp(h)-1.
Equivalent to reference execution of the two lines in forward and to calling elu_forward(hardshrink_forward(x)).
Preserves shape and stride; output is a new tensor with same memory layout as input.
Elementwise hard shrink: output_i = x_i if abs(x_i) > 0.5, else 0.
Input and output are CUDA float32 tensors of shape [16,64,512,512].
Elementwise ELU with alpha=1.0: output_i = x_i if x_i >= 0, else exp(x_i)-1.
Input and output are CUDA float32 tensors of shape [16,64,512,512].
Returns the final CUDA float32 tensor of shape [16,64,512,512].
Value is the result of sequential hardshrink then elu.
